properties.decision:
RECORDED AS AN IDEA FROM TRIAGE, NOT AS A PROPOSAL (Shop session 6, 2026-10-26).

Options:
(a) loop_status takes a `list_cap` (or `all` for one named list).
(b) reasoning_report takes `only: awaiting_the_owners_word` and returns just that list, grouped by what rests on each item.
(c) Leave it: the pointer works, and one larger call is fine.

Cost: (a) and (b) are small.

Counter-argument: loop_status is meant to stay cheap, and every uncapped list is how a digest grows. (b) keeps the digest small and gives the owner a list made for them, which is why it reads better than (a).
properties.name: OPEN — should the list of what awaits the owner's word be readable whole in one cheap call, rather than capped at 20 in loop_status?
properties.rationale: The owner is the one person who can clear this list, so it is the list they most need whole. Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_018ibUbMKCS1yK5W17cncp9P
